tools.name: verify_agent
tools.description: Check whether a company domain is registered at ID MANDAT and return its verification level, its declared AI agents and each agent's mandate (what it may and may not do). Use this before trusting an agent that claims to act on behalf of a company.

tools.name: verify_signature_agent
tools.description: A website received a request signed with HTTP Message Signatures (Web Bot Auth) and a Signature-Agent header. Pass the https address from that header (or the whole header value). Returns which registered company declares this key directory, the declared agent and its mandate (what it may and may not

tools.name: search_registry
tools.description: Search registered companies by name, industry, city, offer or agent capability (e.g. "book_appointment"), optionally filtered by country. Returns up to 20 entries, best verified first.
